chunk_map.heading: A list of don'ts does not teach good work

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L7 "like this one" is closest: its referent is the quoted instruction in the same sentence ("Every quote names the interview it came from"), so it resolves in-chunk; L9 "Those belong in the rules" resolves to the digest and summary named in the two preceding sentences.
No pointer to another file: grep for 'lecture|opening|module|earlier' in body 1-9 returns nothing; the slide only names its own examples.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw' backward references in body

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: not a live-demo beat; no guess/reveal

rules_evaluated.evidence: L3 first paragraph states a self-carrying claim ("A prohibition is a weak instruction: it stops one behaviour and puts nothing in its place."); chunk is one slide of three paragraphs, not a wait-state.
Header "A list of don'ts does not teach good work" vs L3 "they turn into a list of don'ts" and L7 positive form: body supports the header; nothing contradicts it.

Closest: L9 "A digest that ranked what changed. A summary that kept two sources' disagreement in plain view." is a pair of verbless fragments, but they follow the verbed sentence naming the set (L9 "when an agent gets something exactly right") so they are an enumeration, and it is two legs not a triplet. No Not-X-Not-Y-Z, no superlative, no number+retraction, no abstraction-noun stack, no verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Dialect scan of body 1-9: no surface/firing/compendium/forcing function/beat/mood; 'rules' and 'corrections' are ordinary engineer words for an agent's rules file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: grep -c '\*\*' on body lines 1-9 → 0 (no bold at all), inside the <=1 budget.
